title: deepEqual gets dates, NaN and arrays wrong
prompt:
Our `deepEqual` (src/equal.js) is used to skip saving unchanged forms, and it lies: two equal `Date`s compare
unequal, `NaN` is not equal to `NaN`, `[1,2]` equals `{0:1,1:2}`, and objects with an extra `undefined` key compare
equal. Fix it for primitives, arrays, plain objects, Dates (by time) and nested combinations; key order does not
matter; arrays and objects are never equal to each other.
